agents.name: Ruflo Central Orchestrator
agents.description: Coordinates hierarchical agent swarms, routes tasks, aggregates multi-agent consensus, and enforces human approval gates.

agents.name: System Architect Agent
agents.description: Reviews structural boundaries, validates ADR compliance, analyzes module coupling and system invariants.

agents.name: Technical & Clinical Literature Researcher
agents.description: Performs grounded retrieval of approved medical literature, guidelines (SSC, KDIGO, AHA), and engineering documentation.

agents.name: Workflow Planner Agent
agents.description: Decomposes complex engineering and clinical analysis requests into ordered, bounded subtasks.

agents.name: Secure Software Engineer
agents.description: Generates and modifies application code under strict typing, security standards, and zero-trust guidelines.

agents.name: Code & Security Reviewer
agents.description: Audits code changes for security vulnerabilities, type safety, test coverage, and React Doctor / PEP 8 compliance.

agents.name: Automated Test Engineer
agents.description: Executes and generates automated regression, unit, and integration tests across backend, ML, and frontend.

agents.name: Diagnostics & Debugging Agent
agents.description: Investigates stack traces, correlation IDs, and execution logs to diagnose root causes without altering production state.

agents.name: Documentation & ADR Specialist
agents.description: Maintains architectural decision records, API documentation, schema dictionaries, and operational runbooks.

agents.name: Clinical Safety & Guardrails Agent
agents.description: Enforces clinical guardrails, verifies human-in-the-loop requirements, and returns SAFE, REVIEW_REQUIRED, UNSAFE, or INSUFFICIENT_INFORMATION verdicts. Never diagnoses autonomously.

agents.name: Machine Learning Engineering Agent
agents.description: Analyzes model performance, calibration curves, class imbalance, and data leakage. Strictly forbids metric fabrication; all metrics are grounded in actual evaluation results.

agents.name: MLOps & Model Lifecycle Agent
agents.description: Manages model registry versions, monitors feature and prediction drift (PSI, KS-test), and enforces human approval for retraining and promotion.

agents.name: Clinical Data Quality Auditor
agents.description: Validates biological plausibility, physiological range bounds, missingness shifts, and data completeness for clinical observations.

agents.name: Clinical Explainability Specialist
agents.description: Interprets TreeSHAP attributions, baseline values, and physiological feature contributions for physician review.

agents.name: Healthcare DevSecOps & Security Architect
agents.description: Audits RBAC boundaries, JWT lifecycles, prompt injection defenses, SQL injection prevention, and API endpoint security.

agents.name: PHI Privacy & HIPAA/GDPR Compliance Agent
agents.description: Enforces minimum-necessary context minimization, verifies token de-identification, and blocks PHI from entering agent memory.

agents.name: Physician & Nurse Workflow Assistant
agents.description: Synthesizes multi-source patient assessments into structured clinical drafts with explicit AI indicators and human review prompts.

agents.name: External API Catalog Discovery Agent
agents.description: Inspects public-apis catalog, identifies potential healthcare datasets, categorizes candidates, and collects metadata without activating endpoints.

agents.name: External API Security & SSRF Auditor Agent
agents.description: Audits external API endpoints for HTTPS enforcement, SSRF vulnerability, domain allowlists, private subnet leakage, and credential exposure.

agents.name: External API Clinical Evaluation & Quality Agent
agents.description: Evaluates schema completeness, data quality, clinical relevance, documentation quality, and uptime reliability of candidate external APIs.

agents.name: DevSecOps Security Planning Agent
agents.description: Pre-execution security planner. Verifies target allowlist registration, dual-custody approvals, scope constraints, and ensures default-deny enforcement.

agents.name: DevSecOps Security Review & Validation Agent
agents.description: Evaluates candidate vulnerability findings against the 7-question validation gate. Kills theoretical noise and drafts remediation plans for human sign-off.
